mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a comfortable 77 degrees with clear skies over Fireman Park and a waning crescent moon visible.
The City of Verona continues its partnership with AECOM for ongoing engineering services, while the Senior Center offers free rides on a tri-shaw bike along the Military Ridge State Trail.
We have a busy weekend starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at several local venues, and a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena tomorrow.
Reviewing recent activity, on July 31st, an officer stopped a vehicle for equipment violations and arrested the driver for O W I and suspended registration.
Stop by Culver's for an Andes Mint Avalanche before they close at 10:30 PM, and don't forget you can also grab a treat at Fireman Park today until 4 PM where Kona Ice is stationed.
